# Deterministic globe verification sequence.
wait_frames 600
capture initial_birdview

zoom_in 3
wait_frames 120
capture birdview_zoom_in

tilt 45
wait_frames 120
capture tilted_45

zoom_out 2
wait_frames 120
capture tilted_zoom_out

rotate 30
wait_frames 120
capture tilted_rotate

key f
wait_frames 30
capture statistics

reset
wait_frames 120
capture reset

exit
